messages.subject: Update to shiny 0.9.0 / runApp does not start the application
parts:
Dear all,
 
I would assume, it's a very simple mistake.....
 
I do get an error without any additional information:
 
Error: Line starting 'Variable,Explanation ...' is malformed!
 
Using shiny 0.8.0 I never observed this error...
 
and .. it does not happen with every app.
 
What might that be?
Thank you very much
Jürgen

messages.author: d35d6b9b8ef7838b
messages.subject: Re: Update to shiny 0.9.0 / runApp does not start the application
parts:
Hello.

I've faced the same error (Shiny 0.9.1), and after some analysis of the shiny source code&documentation I was able to find a solution.
I guess sometimes the files being included (in my case using includeMarkdown()) are erroneously treated as description file (the one required when you run shiny:runApp() with display.mode="showcase").

Simple creation of empty file named DESCRIPTION (Linux: touch DESCRIPTION) solved my problem.

Thanks,

Cezary
